Transfer cross-check: all-funds transfers 2,547,517 (p16) = governmental 2,483,992 in + internal service fund 63,525 in; out 1,645,207 + 902,310. Internal Service Fund (health insurance, p7-9) is excluded from both groups (not in governmental funds statement). General Fund detail uses the p10 combining schedule (more detailed) instead of the General Fund budget schedule p11-12; General Fund Combining has intra-General Fund transfers between sub-funds. Utility fund budget schedules are not separate (only All Funds budget schedule p15-16, not recorded to avoid double counting with statements). Sales Tax, Economic Development and Keno funds have no detail schedule. Street fund budget schedule total 2,180,981 includes bond/loan proceeds 1,440,000 (recorded as other financing); Street Fund charges for services and Debt Service 'Other' have budget only, no actual. Property and motor vehicle taxes are a single printed line, kept as property tax with review.
